title: Evidence categories and acceptance gates
summary: Host mock tests currently cover RecordSet, SJLJ, API guards and SDK harness; the bundled cfront unwind unit was qualified as host C output. These must remain separate from the 190/199 inherited cc370 result and from all missing MVS/modern z/OS guest gates.
invariants: Use PASS_HOST_MOCK, PASS_HOST_NATIVE, SOURCE_REPORTED, FAILED_GUEST, NOT_RUN and NOT_ESTABLISHED as distinct evidence statuses.
Each successful target claim needs executable/build identity, toolchain, target OS and JES/log or terminal witness.
Native loader and C ABI must be qualified before interpreter execution.
Recheck all 199 source units after a changed backend; alternate compilation is not inherited cc370 evidence.
The Gopher sphere's structural checks are not equivalent to running LLM Gopher's own validate/lint or to target execution.
The dev21 TSO SDK runner refuses a nonempty XMIT as sufficient evidence without the recorded SDK 0.1.0 native-link and SHA receipts.
A synthetic SDK consumer is PASS_HOST_MOCK only; guest return code and qualification fields remain false/null even after a successful host result.
